event.overlay.upNext: Heading of the upcoming-sets stream overlay, listing the sets to be broadcast next.
event.overview.about: Heading over the host's description of the event.
event.pass.add: Button that opens the add-pass dialog; the plus sign is part of the label.
event.pass.add.intro: Under the add-pass dialog's title. A Pass is a kind of admission to an event, with its own price and capacity.
event.pass.add.title: Title of the dialog adding a Pass.
event.pass.availability.available: A Pass's sales state: on sale now.
event.pass.availability.closed: A Pass's sales state: sales have ended.
event.pass.availability.notYetOpen: A Pass's sales state: sales have not started.
event.pass.availability.soldOut: A Pass's sales state: none left.
event.pass.availableFrom: Label of when a Pass goes on sale.
event.pass.availableUntil: Label of when a Pass stops being sold.
event.pass.capacity: Label of how many of a Pass can be sold.
event.pass.capacity.blankUnlimited: Beside the capacity label: an empty field means no limit.
event.pass.capacity.invalid: Error when a Pass capacity is not a whole number of 1 or more.
event.pass.capacity.unlimited: A Pass with no capacity limit; also the capacity field's placeholder.
event.pass.delete.sold: In place of the delete button once a Pass has been sold.
event.pass.delete.title: Asks before deleting a Pass. {name} is its name.
event.pass.delete.unsold: Beside the delete button of a Pass nobody holds.
event.pass.dialog.label: Small label above a Pass's name at the top of its dialog.
event.pass.eligibility.cell: Accessible name of one checkbox in the eligibility grid. {name} is the Pass, {label} the bracket.
event.pass.eligibility.empty: When the eligibility grid has no brackets to show.
event.pass.eligibility.intro: Over the eligibility grid: a row per bracket, a column per Pass.
event.pass.empty: When the event has no Passes. Early Bird and Standard are example names.
event.pass.endSales: Button: stop selling this Pass now.
event.pass.endSales.note: Beside End sales now: people who bought one keep it.
event.pass.manage.label: Accessible name of the Manage button on a Pass. {name} is its name.
event.pass.name: Label of a Pass's name field.
event.pass.name.placeholder: Placeholder of the Pass name field.
event.pass.name.required: Error when a Pass has no name.
event.pass.price: Label of a Pass's price, when the event has no currency yet.
event.pass.price.blankFree: Beside the price label: an empty field means the Pass is free.
event.pass.price.currency: Label of a Pass's price. {currency} is the event's currency code (GBP).
event.pass.price.free: A Pass with no price; also the price field's placeholder.
event.pass.remaining: Fact: how many of a Pass are left to sell.
event.pass.sales: Fact: a Pass's sales state (On sale, Sold out, and so on).
event.pass.sold: Fact: how many of a Pass have been sold.
event.pass.sold.capped: Under a Pass with a capacity. {sold}, {capacity} and {remaining} are numbers.
event.pass.sold.unlimited: Under a Pass with no capacity. {sold} is a number.
event.pass.window: Label of the times a Pass is on sale between.
event.passes.eligibility.title: Heading over the grid of which brackets each Pass lets its holders enter.
event.passes.intro: Under the Passes heading. A Pass is a kind of admission to an event, with its own price and capacity.
event.passes.title: Heading over the event's Passes.
event.payments.account: Label of the picker choosing which Stripe account takes the money. Stripe is the card payment company.
event.payments.account.foreign: The account picker's entry for another host's account. {ownerName} is that host's name.
event.payments.account.foreignHelp: Under the account picker when another host's account is selected. {name} is that host's name.
event.payments.account.none: The account picker's entry when no account is chosen.
event.payments.account.noneOwned: When the viewer has no Stripe account to choose. The Host section is part of their profile page.
event.payments.account.option: An account in the picker. {id} is Stripe's account id; {charges} is enabled once Stripe lets it take payments, otherwise its setup is unfinished.
event.payments.create: Button that creates the event's payment settings for the first time.
event.payments.empty: When the event has no payment settings yet. A payment config is those settings.
event.payments.extra.add: Button adding an extra fee row; the plus sign is part of the label.
event.payments.extra.help: Under the Additional fees heading. VAT is a sales tax; keep the example's quotation marks.
event.payments.extra.invalid: Error when an extra fee row is missing its name or percentage.
event.payments.extra.label.label: Accessible name of an extra fee's name field. {n} is the row's number.
event.payments.extra.label.placeholder: Placeholder of an extra fee's name field.
event.payments.extra.percent.label: Accessible name of an extra fee's percentage field. {n} is the row's number.
event.payments.extra.remove.label: Accessible name of the button removing an extra fee row. {n} is the row's number.
event.payments.extra.title: Heading over the extra fees added to every order.
event.payments.fee.base: Label of the processing fee's fixed part. {currency} is the currency code.
event.payments.fee.description: Under the processing fee switch: orders are raised so the host receives the full price after the card company's fee.
event.payments.fee.invalid: Error when a processing fee field is not a number.
event.payments.fee.percent: Label of the processing fee's percentage part.
event.payments.fee.suggested: Under the processing fee fields: a suggested rate. {base} is an amount, {percent} a number.
event.payments.fee.title: Title of the switch passing the card company's fee on to attendees.
event.payments.onsite.title: Title of the switch letting attendees pay in person.
event.payments.save: Button saving the event's payment settings.
event.payments.stripe.on: Under the card checkout switch when it can be used.
event.payments.stripe.title: Title of the switch taking card payments online through Stripe, the card payment company.
event.payments.stripe.unavailable: Under the card checkout switch when this site has no card processor set up.
event.rail.announcements: A tab of the event page: the host's announcements.
event.rail.attendees: A tab of the event page: who is coming.
event.rail.overview: A tab of the event page: the summary.
event.rail.results: A tab of the event page: how a finished event went.
event.rail.title: Heading of the event page's tabs, and of the button that opens them on a phone.
event.rail.tournaments: A tab of the event page: its brackets.
event.receipt.entry: Tag beside a line of the receipt: a bracket's entry fee.
event.receipt.free: A receipt line that costs nothing.
event.receipt.noCurrency: Under the receipt when the host has not set a currency, so prices cannot be added up.
event.receipt.pass: Tag beside a line of the receipt: a Pass (admission ticket type).
event.receipt.title: Heading of the receipt in the registration form.
event.receipt.unpriced: A receipt line whose price cannot be shown because the event has no currency.
event.register.as: Label of the name fields in the registration form.
event.register.closed.title: Heading when registration is closed.
event.register.discount.label: Field label: a discount code.
event.register.discount.placeholder: Placeholder of the discount code field.
event.register.enter: The submit button when registering for an event and entering brackets in the same step; {n} is how many brackets were picked.
event.register.full.title: Heading when the event is full.
event.register.method.card: Payment choice: pay by card online now.
event.register.method.desk: Payment choice: pay staff at the venue.
event.register.method.legend: Question over the two payment choices.
event.register.notYetOpen.title: Heading when registration has not opened yet.
event.register.pass.help.choose: Under the Pass picker when both payment choices are offered below it.
event.register.pass.help.desk: Under the Pass picker when priced Passes are paid at the venue.
event.register.pass.help.informational: Under the Pass picker when the event takes no payments on the site: prices are for information only.
event.register.pass.help.online: Under the Pass picker when priced Passes are paid online.
event.register.pass.label: Field label: the Pass (admission ticket type) the person registers with.
event.register.pass.option: A Pass in the picker. `{name}` is the Pass, `{price}` its price already formatted.
event.register.pass.optionLeft: A Pass in the picker with limited places. `{n}` is how many are left.
event.register.prefix.label: Accessible name of the prefix field: a sponsor or team tag shown before the player's name.
event.register.public: Under the name fields of the registration form: tells the person, in words a 13-year-old can read, that the name they enter becomes public. A link to the privacy notice follows it.
event.register.signIn.action: Button to sign in, for someone signed out who wants to register.
event.register.signIn.body: Registration box for someone signed out.
event.register.spectator: The submit button when registering for an event without entering any bracket.
event.register.tag.placeholder: Placeholder of the name field: the player's tag (their gaming name).
event.register.title: Heading of the registration box.
event.register.total: Label beside the amount the person will pay.
event.register.tournaments: Heading of the brackets the person can enter while registering.
event.registered.edit: Button that edits the viewer's registration, and the heading of the form it opens.
event.registered.kicker: Small label over the viewer's name once they are registered.
event.registered.noRefund: Under a paid registration: withdrawing does not give the money back.
event.registered.paidOnline: Fact on the viewer's registration: they paid online.
event.registered.payAtDesk: Fact on the viewer's registration: what they owe at the venue. `{amount}` is formatted money.
event.registered.refunded: Fact on the viewer's registration: money was given back and they are still registered. `{amount}` is formatted money.
event.registered.spectating: The viewer is registered but entered no bracket.
event.registered.tournaments: Heading of the brackets the viewer entered. `{n}` is how many.
event.registration.closed: Beside the registration switch when it is off.
event.registration.closed.help: Under the registration switch when it is off.
event.registration.open: Beside the registration switch when it is on.
event.registration.open.help: Under the registration switch when it is on.
event.registration.title: Heading of the switch that opens or closes the event's registration.
event.results.attendedAs: On a finished event the viewer attended. `<b>` wraps the name they attended under.
event.results.movers: Heading of the players whose rating moved most at this event.
event.results.noMovers: When no rating moved enough to list.
event.results.noUpsets: When no lower seed beat a higher one.
event.results.title: Heading of a finished event's results.
event.results.upset: One upset: a lower seed beat a higher one. `<b>` wraps the winner, `<link>` the loser (it sets only the weight, it is not a link), `<code>` each seed number.
event.results.upsets: Heading of the list of upsets.
event.role.captain: Name of the Captain role, which runs one stage or pool of a tournament, on a badge.
event.role.captain.option: The Captain role in the role picker, with what it can cover.
event.role.host: Name of the Host role, which runs the event, on a badge. An organiser credit is a Host role.
event.role.host.option: The Host role in the role picker, with what it can cover.
event.role.streamer: Name of the Streamer role, which runs a stream's queue, on a badge.
event.role.streamer.option: The Streamer role in the role picker, with what it can cover.
event.role.to: Name of the TO (tournament organiser) role, which runs one tournament, on a badge.
event.role.to.option: The TO (tournament organiser) role in the role picker, with what it can cover.
event.roles.add: Button that opens the add-role form; the plus sign is part of the label.
event.roles.add.title: Title of the form that grants someone a role on the event.
event.roles.captainScope: Under the stage and pool pickers when granting the Captain role.
event.roles.column.scope: Column heading in the staff and organiser tables: where a role applies.
event.roles.column.staff: Column heading in the staff table: the person holding the role.
event.roles.empty: In the staff table when nobody holds a role.
event.roles.hostScoped: Under the tournament picker when granting the Host role: what a Host limited to one tournament can do.
event.roles.noStages: When granting the Captain role on a tournament with no stages to pick.
event.roles.noStreams: When granting the Streamer role on an event with no streams to pick.
event.roles.orPool: Label of the pool picker, under the stage picker: the ellipsis continues from it.
event.roles.pick.scope: Error when a Captain grant names neither a stage nor a pool.
event.roles.pick.tournament: Error when a TO grant names no tournament.
event.roles.pick.user: Error when the add-role form has no person picked.
event.roles.revoke: Button that takes a role away from someone, and the confirm button of the dialog asking first.
event.roles.revoke.description: Dialog body under the role-revocation question; {scope} is where the role applied.
event.roles.revoke.self: Why a Host cannot take their own Host role away.
event.roles.revoke.title: Question asked before an event role is revoked; {role} is the role's label, {name} the person.
event.roles.role: Label of the role picker, and the column heading of the role in the staff and organiser tables.
event.roles.scope.wholeEvent: In the organiser table's Scope column: the credit covers the whole event, not one bracket.
event.roles.selectTournament: Placeholder of the tournament picker when a tournament is required.
event.roles.stage: Label of the stage picker when granting the Captain role.
event.roles.stream: Label of the stream picker when granting the Streamer role.
event.roles.streamerScope: Under the stream picker when granting the Streamer role. A DQ is a disqualification.
event.roles.tournament: Label of the tournament picker when granting a role.
event.roles.wholeEventDefault: The tournament picker's choice for a Host role over the whole event.
event.schedule.add: Button that adds a time to the event's running order, and the title of the dialog it opens.
event.schedule.dateTba: The event's schedule when it has no date yet.
event.schedule.dialog.help: Under the add or edit dialog's title for a time on the running order.
event.schedule.edit.label: Accessible name of the edit button on one time. {label} is what happens at that time.
event.schedule.edit.title: Title of the dialog editing a time on the running order.
event.schedule.empty.body: Under the empty running order's title.
event.schedule.empty.title: When the event's running order has no times yet.
event.schedule.entered: Accessible name of the mark beside a schedule line for a bracket the viewer entered.
event.schedule.intro: Intro to the Schedule settings: the event page draws one row per day of the event.
event.schedule.nothing: A day of the event with nothing on the schedule.
event.schedule.remove.label: Accessible name of the remove button on one time. {label} is what happens at that time.
event.schedule.timeTba: Heading over schedule lines with no time yet.
event.schedule.what: Label of the field saying what happens at a time (doors, a break, the awards).
event.schedule.when: Label of the time field on the running order.
event.settings.health.adjustCap: Link on a setup health item saying the event is full: opens the registration settings holding its cap.
event.settings.health.reopen: Link on a setup health item saying registration is closed: opens the registration settings.
event.settings.health.setWindow: Link on a setup health item saying registration has no opening and closing times: opens the registration settings.
event.settings.node.discountCodes: A node in the event page's Settings tree, under Commerce: the event's discount codes.
event.settings.node.duplicate: A node in the event page's Settings tree: make a copy of this event as a new one.
event.settings.node.payments: A node in the event page's Settings tree, under Commerce: entry fees, the currency and how the event takes payment.
event.settings.node.registration: A node in the event page's Settings tree: when and how players sign up.
event.settings.node.schedule: A node in the event page's Settings tree: the event's timetable.
event.settings.node.tournaments: A node in the event page's Settings tree: the event's tournaments (brackets), each listed with whether it is public.
event.settle.action: Button that records a payment taken at the venue. `{amount}` is formatted money.
event.settle.cardRefunds: On the payment desk: where card refunds are made, and that refunding and withdrawing are separate.
event.settle.column.amount: Column heading on the payment desk's takings.
event.settle.column.item: Column heading on the payment desk's takings: what was sold.
event.settle.discounts: Line in the takings: money taken off by discount codes.
event.settle.gross: Last line of the takings: the total, and how many people paid. `{n}` is a number.
event.settle.markRefunded: Button that records money given back at the venue.
event.settle.owes: Tag on an attendee who still owes money. `{amount}` is formatted money.
event.settle.refundedBadge: Tag on an attendee given money back, all of it (`yes`) or part of it (`other`). `{amount}` is formatted money.
event.settle.refundedNotice: Warning under an attendee given money back, all of it (`yes`) or part of it (`other`): they are still registered.
event.settle.taken: Heading of the money taken, by Pass and bracket.
event.setupHealth.attendanceFull: A row on the event's setup checklist. {count} is how many are registered, {cap} the most the event takes.
event.setupHealth.eventPrivate: A row on the event's setup checklist, read by its host.
event.setupHealth.registrationClosed: A row on the event's setup checklist.
event.setupHealth.registrationUnconfigur: A row on the event's setup checklist: no opening and closing time for registration.
event.setupHealth.streamNotRouted: A row on the event's setup checklist. {name} is one of the event's brackets; routing a stream points a broadcast at it.
event.setupHealth.unpublishedDraft: A row on the event's setup checklist. {name} is one of the event's brackets (tournaments).
event.setupHealth.unseeded: A row on the event's setup checklist. {name} is one of the event's brackets; seeding is the starting order of its entrants.
event.streamControl.moveDown: Button label (read by screen readers) moving a set one place later in the stream queue; {label} names the set, usually its two players.
event.streamControl.moveUp: Button label (read by screen readers) moving a set one place earlier in the stream queue; {label} names the set, usually its two players.
event.streamControl.nothingOnStream: Shown in the stream control window when no set is being broadcast.
event.streamControl.queue: Heading over the list of sets waiting to be broadcast on one stream, in order.
event.streamControl.queueEmpty: Shown when a stream has no sets queued. "The stream row" is the stream section inside a set's dialog.
event.streamControl.remove: Button label (read by screen readers) taking a set out of the stream queue; {label} names the set, usually its two players.
event.streamControl.seat: Badge on a queued place held for a stage that has not started yet, so it has no set to play.
event.streamControl.seatWaiting: Shown in the stream control window when the first place in the queue is held for a stage that has not started.
event.streamControl.stageFallback: Where a queued set comes from, when its stage has no name; {position} is the stage's order in the tournament.
event.streamControl.title: Title of the pop-out window a stream producer keeps open to run the stream queue and report the set on air. Also its browser tab title.
event.streamOverlays.copy: Tooltip on a button copying a stream overlay's address, to paste into broadcasting software.
event.streamOverlays.open: Tooltip on a button opening a stream overlay in a new browser tab.
event.streamOverlays.view.overview: Name of the stream overlay showing the pool around the set on air: its standings, or the sets feeding into and out of it.
event.streamOverlays.view.scoreboard: Name of the stream overlay showing the two players on air and their score.
event.streamOverlays.view.stage: Name of the full-screen stream overlay showing a whole stage's bracket or grid, for breaks between sets.
event.streamOverlays.view.upcoming: Name of the stream overlay listing the sets queued to be broadcast next.
event.streamSides.announce: Screen-reader announcement after the scoreboard sides are swapped; {left} and {right} are the entrants now on each side.
event.streamSides.heading: Heading of the control that picks which half of the stream's scoreboard each player is drawn on.
event.streamSides.left: The left half of the stream's scoreboard, above the player drawn there.
event.streamSides.right: The right half of the stream's scoreboard, above the player drawn there.
event.streamSides.switch: Button label (read by screen readers) swapping which half of the scoreboard each player is drawn on.
event.tournaments.all: Heading over the buttons that act on every bracket of the event at once.
event.tournaments.column.public: Column heading in the Tournaments grid: whether the bracket is listed on the site.
event.tournaments.column.registration: Column heading in the Tournaments grid: whether the bracket takes entries.
event.tournaments.column.tournament: Column heading in the Tournaments grid: the bracket's name.
event.tournaments.empty: When the event has no tournaments. The second sentence shows for a Host ({host} is yes), who can add one with the button above.
event.tournaments.imported: Tooltip in place of the registration checkbox on a bracket imported from another site.
event.tournaments.intro: Over the Tournaments grid. Registration and Public name its two columns. The last sentence depends on the viewer: site staff ({moderator} is yes) read what hiding does to ratings, a Host reads when a bracket locks.
event.tournaments.openSeeding: Link on a Tournaments grid row to that bracket's own page, where it is seeded and run.
event.tournaments.public.label: Accessible name of a row's Public checkbox. {label} is the bracket's name.
event.tournaments.public.locked: Tooltip of a Public checkbox that can no longer change.
event.tournaments.registration.label: Accessible name of a row's Registration checkbox. {label} is the bracket's name.
event.visibility.private.action: Button that takes the event off the public site, and the confirm button of the dialog asking first.
event.visibility.private.registered: Dialog body warning what making an event private does to the people already registered; {n} is how many.
event.visibility.private.title: Title of the dialog asking before an event with registrations is made private.
event.visibility.publish.action: Button that puts the event on the public site, and the confirm button of the dialog asking first.
event.visibility.publish.noDrafts: Body of the publish dialog when the event has no draft brackets.
event.visibility.publish.title: Title of the dialog asking before an event is published.
event.visibility.publish.withDrafts: Body of the publish dialog when draft brackets will be published too; their list follows the colon.
event.yourRun.go: Link to the bracket where the viewer's next set is.
event.yourRun.on: Label over the viewer's set that is being played now.
event.yourRun.tbd: In place of the viewer's next opponent while that is still being decided.
event.yourRun.up: Label over the viewer's set that is called next.
